summary: Sandbach United kicked off their 2026/27 season with a matchday fixture against Stafford Town, two sides with recent play-off ambitions facing off in what promised to be a competitive encounter. The NWCFL Premier Division got underway with some impressive performances elsewhere, including Burscough's 4-1 victory over Prestwich Heys and Trafford's 3-0 home win against Longridge Town. Fans were encouraged to get behind The Bach with affordable ticket prices available.
